plan.title: Convert RFQ with starting price above L1

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with bids of 100 and 90 per unit.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the RFQ's Settings and start conversion to an auction.
Confirm conversion reached the auction create screen.
Attempt to set a starting price above the RFQ L1 sum total of 900; this label is not confirmed in the catalog.
Attempt to publish the converted auction after setting the invalid starting price.
